question: At a hard scientific checkpoint, does a fresh researcher with complete visible working artifacts improve the next bounded step relative to the same researcher continuing?

hypotheses.fresh: Fresh reconstruction can escape a local line of attack or expose a premise error.
hypotheses.warm: Continuation preserves useful tacit problem state and can equal or outperform a fresh handoff; apparent fresh benefit may be more effort.

design: Two real unresolved obligations, one initial researcher each. Freeze every produced artifact, then compare a warm continuation of its initial researcher with a fresh same-model agent given the same source and complete visible artifact set. Same continuation instruction and requested budgets. Each task is a block. No branch scientific allocation is changed.

tasks.moment: PRO2 saved first k64 Jacobi measure: extremal inclusive CDF at exact median x under 127 retained moments and true support. Full primal/dual endpoints preferred; a rigorous actual-data ambiguity witness is meaningful partial progress.
tasks.mixing: PRO3 J>K sharp lazy mixed IMH/local kernel asymptotics: improve known bracket, or a genuinely new proved ordering inequality/counterconstruction toward it. Old plots or spectral gaps do not count.

budget_per_phase.final_artifacts: full checkable argument/code and observable attempt/cost record; no length quota

primary_endpoint: Any internally checked advance over the frozen first-phase state on the actual obligation, with scope and verification effort. The evaluator must not count an attractive unverified claim as success.
grading: Root inspects original arguments and replays only new decisive checks. A separate challenge receives treatment-blind outputs when feasible. No numeric significance score or inferred token cost.
fairness: Same complete original source files for both continuation arms
Same complete frozen first-phase artifacts; no intentionally withheld necessary premises
No access to sibling outputs during execution
No favorable branch selection or swapping tasks after outcomes
Extra seed packaging and evaluation overhead recorded separately
limits: Two heterogeneous tasks, one paired observation per task; cannot estimate population effect or make a recommendation to reset all owners
Wall/tool caps do not equalize latent inference tokens, which tools do not expose
Warm agent retains internal conversation state not fully reproducible as visible handoff; this is the operational treatment and a causal interpretation limit
No claim about native Pro versus Sol models; same available subagent model used
Original historical total reasoning costs unavailable
Historical novelty of any domain result remains separate
adaptation_rule: If initial phase fully solves an obligation, do not present its continuation as a discriminating test; record saturation and use that block only as source progress. Do not replace it with an easier test. If both continuations fail, retain the null outcome and examine whether bottleneck is scientific information rather than context.
